slides.title: US tells agencies to remove DeepSeek
body: The US ordered federal civilian agencies to stop buying products from **DeepSeek**, a Chinese AI startup, and remove them from government IT systems, according to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

slides.title: It covers apps built on DeepSeek too

facts.text: The US ordered federal civilian agencies to stop purchasing services and products developed by Chinese AI startup DeepSeek and remove them from government IT systems over national security concerns, according to the Department of Homeland Security.
The order also covers third-party products and services built using DeepSeek technology, though agencies can request exceptions.
DHS warned that sensitive information from US government users could potentially be accessible to Chinese authorities under Chinese law, the order said.

A law passed in December 2025 targeted DeepSeek's use in intelligence's national security systems. The latest order extends the restrictions to federal civilian agencies, covering both new purchases and existing IT systems.

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said Beijing opposes "overstretching the concept of national security and politicizing technology and trade issues," and added: "We will resolutely safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises."

sources.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China's DeepSeek AI from their systems

caption:
One government just told its agencies to drop a Chinese AI model.

The US ordered federal civilian agencies to stop buying DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, and remove it from government IT systems, according to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

→ It also covers third-party products built with DeepSeek technology (exceptions can be requested)
→ DHS says US government users' sensitive data could be accessible to Chinese authorities under Chinese law
→ Beijing says it opposes "politicizing technology and trade issues"

Will other governments and companies follow with similar rules?

Source: TechCrunch, "US orders federal agencies to remove China's DeepSeek AI from their systems", Oct 20, 2026.
